snippet.title: KEYKRUNCHER™ - Reveal Trailer | From the creators of RATSHAKER™
snippet.description:
After our last video, Sunscorched Studios is a much smaller team.

There are three of us left now.

We are smaller than ever, but we are still here and still making games. We are rebuilding the studio around strange, experimental horror games for people who enjoy ideas that probably should not exist.

KEYKRUNCHER™ is not Negative Atmosphere.

We cannot make Negative Atmosphere right now. That game would need a level of funding, time, and production support that we simply do not have.

But we still want to make horror games.

RATSHAKER™ was a game about shaking a rat to find your wife.

KEYKRUNCHER™ is a game about eating a keyboard, one keycap at a time.

Enrolment is now open.

You have been fused to a desk in an assessment room with a scrambled keyboard, a gumball machine, and IT waiting at the end of the hallway.

Press the correct keys on your real keyboard to KRUNCH matching keycaps in-game. Obey the monitor. Clear escalating treatment lessons. Earn tokens. Feed the gumball machine. Pull cursed rewards. Curate the perfect treatment desk whilst rapidly losing your mind.

KEYKRUNCHER™ is currently in early development and targeting a 2026 release on PC via Steam. A free demo is planned for later this year.

Steam page live now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4887630/KEYKRUNCHER/

Sunscorched Studios:
https://sunscorchedstudios.co.uk
